arguments.cmd:
cd /tmp/lenparam && python3 -c "
src = open('model.scad').read()
src = src.replace('[[0, 0, 0], [30, 41, 14.9]]', '[[0, 0, 0], [30, 41, 13.6]]')
open('model.scad','w').write(src)
print('ok')
"
timeout 280 cadcheck behaviour --out-dir /tmp/lenparam/bout model.scad 2>&1 | grep -E 'force_n|strain_pct|deflection_mm|depth_mm|past the|to ride over|not computed|"held"|comes off' | head -25

result.stdout:
ok
      "not computed: the assembly has to pass G3 and G4 first, since a force is computed on the depth G4 measures"
      "disc is not held: printed in place, it comes off the others moving along +y, +z. An assembly printed in place comes off the bed in one piece, each part held by the others (a pin capped at both ends, a pivot in a closed bore)",
      "finger is not held: printed in place, it comes off the others moving along -y, -z. An assembly printed in place comes off the bed in one piece, each part held by the others (a pin capped at both ends, a pivot in a closed bore)"
